ledger.x: c. 2686 BC: Djoser founds the Old Kingdom (Third Dynasty) at Memphis. Page: 'The first King of the Old Kingdom was Djoser (sometime between 2691 and 2625 BC)'; reign 'c. 2686 - c. 2649 BC'; infobox 'Began: c. 2686 BC'.
2613: the Fourth Dynasty begins, the Old Kingdom's zenith.
2345: the Sixth Dynasty begins and royal power starts to slip.

c. 2181 BC: the south passes to its nomarchs. The pages name no state in the south between c. 2181 and the Theban Eleventh Dynasty (infobox Thebes c. 2134 BC); that the land was held by the provincial governors is the researcher's bridging reading of 'powerful nomarchs (regional governors)'. Cliopatria instead draws…

c. 2181 BC: the Old Kingdom ends and the First Intermediate Period begins. Page: 'Ended: c. 2181 BC'; 'Internal disorders set in during the incredibly long reign of Pepi II (2278-2214 BC)'; low Niles 'between 2200 and 2150 BC'. First Intermediate Period page: Memphis (c. 2181-c. 2160 BC), Seventh-Eighth Dynasties.

wars.name: Sixth Dynasty expeditions into Canaan
wars.outcome: No territorial result recorded: the page says only 'At least five military expeditions were sent into Canaan' under the Sixth Dynasty.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey borders; the kingdom is the Nile valley and Delta, bounded by desert and by Elephantine in the south.
